quest.title: What the Skies Conceal, the Water Reveals
quest.description: Apart from the spate of unconsciousness caused by the meteorites, the appearance of the Fatui has also aroused your suspicions. Fortunately, the arrival of the astrologist Mona has given your efforts a much-needed boost. With the help of her mystical scrying techniques, you begin to delve into these mysteries...
quest.rewards_formatted: Fragile Resin x1, Primogem x60, Mora x30000

chapter.title: What the Skies Conceal, the Water Reveals

talks.objective: Chat with Mona about the meteorites and scrying

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hi Mona! Thanks to you, we've managed to get rid of loads and loads of meteorites!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Ah, good timing! There's something I need you to do.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Remember how I was saying that the meteorites belonged to someone's constellation?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Theoretically, it's not possible for stars that are goodness knows how many light-years away to suddenly turn into meteors and fall out of the sky. But, however paradoxical it may be, this is the reality.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: If we want to get to the bottom of this, the best way is to find out whose constellation it was.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Based on what you've told me, it seems that all victims of the meteorites fell into a deep sleep, and all of them dreamed of a snowy mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Now, we may not know which mountain this was — but we can safely assume that it's not Dragonspine. Otherwise, someone would have recognized it, right?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Did everyone definitely have the same dream? And where exactly were they in the dream? These are the questions that we need answers to.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I need you to find out more details about the sleepers' dreams. The more information we have, the closer we can get to the truth.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems we should head somewhere with lots of people around.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That way, we should be able to find more victims to question.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I need to stay in an undisturbed environment. So, I will leave the investigating to you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is there anywhere that we haven't been to yet?

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: There is <color=#00E1FFFF>Qingce Village</color>, in Liyue... Although, it does not usually match your suggestion of "somewhere with lots of people around."

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: That said, I suspect that the Millelith will have turned that area into a site where victims can receive medical attention, much as they did at Wangshu Inn.

dialogues.speaker: Gao the Sixth
dialogues.text: Thanks to you, I didn't starve to death in my sleep!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello, we're from the Adventurers' Guild. Can you tell us if Qingce Village has been affected by the meteorite strike?

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: Adventurers! Perfect! I was beginning to despair at the lack of helpers.

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: These meteorite strikes have been going on for days now. Don't even get me started on how much trouble it's caused...

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: If one lands in a <color=#00E1FFFF>field</color>, no one dares to go and harvest the crops, and if one lands <color=#00E1FFFF>at the entrance</color>, access is a complete nightmare.

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: Do you have any ideas on how to safely dispose of them? They're just making everything impossible!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I take it Qingce Village has been affected, then.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess we'd better help this guy out.

talks.objective: Dispose of the meteorites in the fields

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: I really hope you can help us deal with the meteorites.

talks.objective: Dispose of the meteorites in the fields

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Done and dusted!

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: Wonderful! What a huge help!

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Have any of the victims woken since the start of the incident?

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: Oh, I wouldn't know... You're better off just taking a look for yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Mortal! Art thou also descended into the realm of suffering?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Same situation that we've seen in other places, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there. Has this guy woken up at any point?

dialogues.speaker: Huaqing
dialogues.text: No, he has said a few things in his sleep, though.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What kind of things?

dialogues.speaker: Huaqing
dialogues.text: "So cold," "Can't go on," ...Things like that.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The previous victims have said they were cold, too.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Somewhere cold, up in the mountains... Where could it be?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, has this guy woken up at any point?

dialogues.speaker: Yang
dialogues.text: Not so far.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay... Um, has he said anything in his sleep?

dialogues.speaker: Yang
dialogues.text: Now that you mention it... Yesterday, he suddenly cried out "So high!" Who knows what he was dreaming about.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How high? High as a snowy mountain peak, maybe?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: A wicked mountain, its frozen peak looming high, home to a malevolent power...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's talk to that guy over there next.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello, have any of the victims woken up?

dialogues.speaker: Bro Huang
dialogues.text: Funny you should ask! <color=#00E1FFFF>Gao the Sixth</color> literally just woke up.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright! We're gonna go talk to him.

dialogues.speaker: Bro Huang
dialogues.text: That's fine, but he's only just awoken and is still very weak. If you must question him, please be gentle.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Greetings, you who have suffered and lived to tell the tale. Your sovereign shall question you now.

dialogues.speaker: Gao the Sixth
dialogues.text: Food... Need food...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you okay? Sounds like you're starving.

dialogues.speaker: Gao the Sixth
dialogues.text: Ugh... Oof...

choices.text: What are you hungry for? Any dish you like.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Home cooking from Qingce Village? Well that can only mean one thing: <color=#00E1FFFF>farmer food</color>!

choices.text: I'll cook a meal for you.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Try some Qingce Stir Fry — you won't find a more delicious bargain anywhere!

talks.objective: Bring Gao the Sixth some Qingce Stir Fry

dialogues.speaker: Gao the Sixth
dialogues.text: Phwoar! That's brought me back from the brink, that has!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you have a dream while you were sleeping?

dialogues.speaker: Gao the Sixth
dialogues.text: Only the most exhausting dream of my whole life!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Why, what happened?

response.speaker: Gao the Sixth
response.text: Yes... how did you know? Way up in the mountains, the highest mountain I've ever seen... It was freezing up there.

response.speaker: Gao the Sixth
response.text: I'm not sure. It's like I was... possessed. I was consumed by the idea of climbing up the mountain and trying to reach the summit.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Was there something special at the summit, or?

response.speaker: Gao the Sixth
response.text: Who knows? Honestly, it's like I became a completely different person in my dream. Don't ask me why, I have no idea...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So it wasn't "you" who wanted to climb the mountain?

response.speaker: Gao the Sixth
response.text: It's hard to describe... It's like I was being controlled, as if somebody else put the idea of climbing the mountain into my head. I know how crazy that sounds, but...

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: An intruder trespassed in the dark recesses of your soul!?

response.speaker: Oz
response.text: An idea not autonomously generated by the individual, but that appeared within the subconscious... Yes, the signs do indeed point towards mind control.

choices.text: I should be used to this by now, but...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: All the other victims we've met have talked about being cold, and needing to rest... Were they all climbing the mountain, too?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How can they all be having the same dream?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon doesn't even wanna think about it... We need to update <color=#00E1FFFF>Mona</color> on all of this!

choices.text: The things you two say are not even remotely similar...
Were you outside in the snow?

response.speaker: Gao the Sixth
response.text: Well, sort of. Up a snowy mountain, to be precise. It was huge, and it was freezing cold... The moment I fell asleep, I was standing at the foot of the mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mona, we found some stuff out!

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: An ice-capped mountain looms over the world from far above the clouds... That is the place from which this burgeoning darkness proceeds.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Ice-capped mountain? Is that all?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It is the same ice-capped mountain in everyone's dream.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's a really really high mountain that no one's ever seen before, and it's super cold up there. The sleepers are forced to try and climb to the summit, but they don't know why.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Climb the mountain? To the summit?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: What sort of person would wish to reach the summit of that mountain? And how is their desire strong enough to exert an influence on others?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Perchance some poor soul lies there, buried in the snow, hounded to death on the mountain?

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Or... Some intrepid explorer was exceptionally keen to conquer that particular mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I'll do another reading!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Aha! I see something here... It's a little vague but I think I can get his name... Ah, yes! <color=#00E1FFFF>"Leonard"</color>!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, that was fast!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Well, in case you'd forgotten... I am a genius!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Leonard..." Paimon's never heard that name before.

dialogues.speaker: The Balladeer
dialogues.text: Hi!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Any junior fortune-teller could have told you this, but... That man was a Fatui Harbinger! That was too close, how did you manage to get caught up with a guy like him?

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: A Fatui Harbinger? Why, their wickedness knows no bounds!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A Harbinger? Goodness...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Whatever he was planning to do... He was heading straight for you.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: And he is an extremely powerful individual! I sensed it the moment I looked at him. He's far more powerful than you'd imagine.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: As much as it pains me to admit it...

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Surely his power cannot match that of the astrological genius of the century?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I never said that...! His strength may exceed mine by a hair's breadth... But in astrology alone, he doesn't come close!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This reminds Paimon of something... We ran into some Fatui at Wangshu Inn, too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What interest could the Fatui have in the meteorites?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: They must be plotting something.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Hmm... Maybe, just maybe...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! The Fatui are the ones who caused the meteor shower in the first place! Was that it?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Paimon, that was my line! Get your own!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sorry... Paimon's mouth just works so much faster than everyone else's.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Does the power to summon a meteorite strike really exist?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah... Where'd they get the power to pull stars out of the sky!?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Ozvaldo Hrafnavins, what is thy opinion?

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: I think that anything is possible, mein Fräulein.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: So long as they can afford to pay the price, they will never stop sowing their seeds of destruction across the land... Fatui, your sins shall not go unremembered.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: I also believe that miracles can happen.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Astral emissary, you have performed admirably as a member of my retinue. I will dispatch my forces to protect you, and they will ensure that the encroaching darkness shall bring you no harm.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: She means me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No need! Paimon thinks that our current lineup works just fine... No need to fix it if it ain't broke!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: You underestimate me, Fischl! I'm far stronger than you seem to think.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Mein Fräulein trusts no one more than yourself, my lady, she is simply concerned for your well-being.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: There's really no need. In any case, you're in a much more perilous position than I am. If anything, you need my protection.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: For now, we must deal with the new threat. My astrolabe tells me that a new meteorite has landed, and it's the <color=#00E1FFFF>biggest one yet</color>.

talks.objective: Head to the spot where the giant meteorite made landfall

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Wow. That's a big one.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: This is the one.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: I sense an unprecedented amount of elemental energy within.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: The very heart of darkness descends upon the world.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do the Fatui want with this? Is it the elemental power?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: It's possible... But if that were the case, other life forms would surely be drawn to the meteorites' energy too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's take a closer look.

dialogues.speaker: Gao the Sixth
dialogues.text: Food... Need food...
